reason: A chat-integrated host filesystem browser that lists directories, reads limited files, and supports dragging paths or images into conversations.

summaries.zh: 在聊天界面中浏览主机文件系统，按名称、大小或修改时间排序，并将文件路径或支持的图片拖入对话。
summaries.en: Browse the host filesystem in the chat interface, sort entries by name, size, or modification time, and drag file paths or supported images into conversations.

capabilities: Browse directories and files on the host machine
Read limited-size files through a local GET API
Insert file paths into chat drafts or send them to the agent
Attach supported images dragged into the chat
Copy paths or open files with the system default application
